newsitem.title: USA: LPC - UCAR to close $590 mln refinancing.
newsitem.headline: LPC - UCAR to close $590 mln refinancing.

text.p: NEW YORK, March 12 (LPC) - Chase Manhattan Corp next Wednesday plans to close its $590 million amendment to the existing $630 million loan for UCAR International, according to a company official.
The $590 million facility is structured as a $200 million revolver, a $270 million A term loan and a $120 million B term loan.

Pricing is tied to leverage and starts at 75 basis points over the London Inter-Bank Offered Rate (LIBOR) on the revolver and term loan A, 150 basis points over LIBOR on B term loan. There is a 25 basis point commitment fee.
The first two tranches mature in 2001, while the B term matures in 2002.
The amount of the loan is being reduced because of repayments by the company, the official said.
